integrity: An exact standalone verifier and its recorded output are embedded. Algebraic Morse cancellation, a determinant-one-in-absolute-value minor and signed Lefschetz computation substantiate the proof.
scientific_limitations: Finite result for the Paley graph of order 13 at parameter two. No other Paley orders, no integral orbit-space homology, no equivariant homotopy type. Literature priority is best-knowledge only; independent review has not been performed.
title: Mixed sphere homotopy and affine integral homology of the Paley-thirteen dissociation complex
